ruling.recommended_action: Issue a $8.22 Ryde voucher to the rider for the two unexempted detour segments (RD-2); no account flag.
ruling.reasoning:
Two off-route segments are recorded on this RydeTAXI trip: 22:56–23:04 adding 2.46 km [F3] and 23:08–23:14 adding 3.37 km [F4]. RD-1 makes each such segment reviewable under RD-3/RD-4/RD-5, and nothing on this record exempts either of them.

No rider message precedes either segment — there are no in-app chat messages at all [F9] — so no consent was given before 22:56 or before 23:08, and the driver's post-trip statement "The GPS rerouted me" [F10] is a claim written after the fact, which cannot establish consent [RD-5]. No stop was requested by the rider [F9], so RD-3 does not apply.

There is also no reasonable cause: no traffic incident was recorded near the route during the trip window [F13], and the only speed records are EAST COAST PARKWAY and AIRPORT BOULEVARD at band 4, 30–39 km/h [F11][F12], which is neither an incident under RD-4(a) nor the band 1–2 congestion RD-4(b) contemplates, and in any event a band alone does not exempt a segment [RD-4]. Weather was fair [F14]. Both segments are therefore unexempted detours refundable under RD-2.

Amount: this is a metered RydeTAXI fare, so the refund is Σ(unexempted segment extra_km) × the trip's per-km rate. The rate is the fare record's distance fare ÷ distance km = $1.4099/km [F5]. 2.46 km + 3.37 km = 5.83 km; 5.83 km × $1.4099/km = $8.2197 → $8.22 [F3][F4][F5][RD-2]. The remaining ~0.66 km of the billed 6.49 km excess [F1][F5] lies in the route corridor and is expressly not refunded [RD-2]. The $0.02 meter waiting unit [F6] is a genuine RydeTAXI meter charge and is not refundable [RD-3(c)][F8].

Account flag: the driver's profile shows 0 upheld disputes and 0 route disputes in 90 days [F16], so RD-6's "repeated" condition is not met and no flag_account is added [RD-6].

segment_findings.reason: Off-route segment 22:56–23:04 adding 2.46 km. No rider message exists before 22:56 — the chat record is empty [F9] — and the driver's later statement [F10] is a claim, not consent (G11); no incident qualifies under RD-4 [F13]. Unexempted detour refundable under RD-2 [RD-1][RD-3][RD-4][RD-5].

Off-route segment 23:08–23:14 adding 3.37 km. Again no rider message before 23:08 [F9], the rider-requested-stop branch is not met [F9], and only non-qualifying band 4 traffic is recorded [F11][F12][F13]. Unexempted detour refundable under RD-2 [RD-1][RD-3][RD-4][RD-5].

rejected_claims.reason: The $0.02 waiting item is not refundable: on a metered RydeTAXI trip the meter waiting unit is charged per RD-3(c) and appears as a genuine $0.02 charge in the bill [F6][F8]; only the segment kilometres are refunded [RD-2].

The +14.3 min duration against the 28.4 min estimate [F2] cannot increase the refund: RD-2 refunds only the metered distance units of unexempted segments, and part of the longer duration is attributable to band 4 flow on the corridor [F11][F12][F8].

The driver's point that no FARE-1 adjustment applies is correct as to the $0.02 [F6][F8], but it does not defeat the rider's distance claim: the billed excess distance was collected inside the metered total [F5][F8] and is refundable under RD-2.
